split: official train/val/test files, no block mixing
input: XYZ + train-normalized Reflectance; RGB excluded for common architecture
class_protocol: All11 valid classes, no ignored other class
features: frozen medium U-Net dec1 48 channels; matched random seed42; trainable48to9 projection
fusion: input+stage1; no quality modulation or reliability descriptors
fixed_unseen_degradation: same medium segmenter and medium U-Net all severities
evaluation_extent: 8192 sampled points per block; not full-cloud benchmark
revision: v2 corrected reflectance, independent repeat sampling, matched optimizer updates
checkpoint_selection: validation mIoU only; no test-guided selection
class_weighting: inverse sqrt expected class frequency under uniform-block sampling; mean normalized and clipped .5..8
